text_block_list.text: Katsuragi Ace's racing Racewear, which had been sent out for maintenance, has arrived. So—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's go for a run then!
I wanna check how this feels to wear, too!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? That is—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*... This won't do at all...
Not with such pathetic footwork...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
—Kh, haah, haah... my time...
It's not improving at all...

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Those guys...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, mind if I take
those guys along for running practice?"

Judging by the look on Katsuragi Ace's face,
she seemed to have an idea.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Yo, you guys.
Come with me for a bit.

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Hoo, hoo...! Alright, picking up the pace a bit~!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *gasp*...!
Ngh... s-so fast...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
—Alright, let's take a break soon.
Good work, you two.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... Y-Yes...! I'm so sorry,
my stamina is totally shot...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...T-To be worn out by just this much... It's utterly pathetic of me...!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Haha, feeling this frustrated just means you've got a dream you take that seriously, right?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: What kind of dream was it?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
To become an ideal princess...
just like PriFai...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I-I also... want to run well in races
and revitalize my hometown, Tomakomai!
But...――

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that's a nice dream.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
—My dream is
to become the ace of the Umamusume world.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"To do that, we gotta
overcome every single obstacle in our way."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: "I gotta wipe out all the tough ones and show 'em all just how strong I really am—"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
That is... well...
To achieve something that grand, the obstacles standing in your way must be just as huge, right...?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. We hit walls all the time.
And every single one of 'em is ridiculously massive.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Still...
When that happens, there's only one thing to do, right?"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Umm—smash it to pieces!
Maybe...?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
That's it! Smashing through is the only way!
Once I set my mind to it, I do it. Full speed ahead!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
So that goes for you guys too.
We'll run until we break through the wall! Until our dreams come true!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I'll take the lead.
You guys just chase after my back!!

*Whoosh*—Katsuragi Ace's jacket flutters back.
And on her back—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: “Katsuragi Ace”—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Carrying their names upon my back... Showing them this back of mine, I will run ahead of everyone...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What audacious spirit...! So this is
what Ace-san's resolve truly looks like...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I have to... get fired up too!
Clench my fists! And go smash it to pieces!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...! I'll break through the time barrier,
and any other wall in my way!
choice_data_list: You really are an "Ace" to these kids now.
You're definitely an "Ace" to these kids now.
Let's break down the wall together.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...! I'll break through the time barrier,
and any other wall in my way!
choice_data_list: You really are an "Ace" to these kids now.
You're definitely an "Ace" to these kids now.
Let's break down the wall together.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Yes! I'll follow in Ace-san's footsteps and face down any hardship that comes my way!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's the spirit!
We're racing on the way back, bring it on!!

Leading the younger students, Katsuragi Ace's back
somehow looked remarkably large and dependable.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Swing your shoulders and clench your fists!
—Let's go, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'm going to blow them all away!
Take thiiiisss!!

Full of energy, the three dashed along the return path,
their voices ringing out loud and strong.
